name: Tronscan API (TRON block explorer: account details and public labels)
tier_rationale: The TRON DAO's official block explorer API with published terms and a business offering (A8 trusted); P207 cond 5 'TronGrid/Tronscan (TRON DAO) tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Explorer view of public TRON state; labels and tags are the explorer's own curation (published as such).

tronscan.description: Tronscan API key (TRON-PRO-API-KEY header, never in a URL); without it the API answers 401
tronscan.plan_hint: a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal in key_plans (P207 cond 5) - never a personal free account

api.title: Tronscan apilist.tronscanapi.com/api/accountv2?address= (labels and account details, key only)

terms.quote: Tronscan (apilist.tronscanapi.com) only with key 'tronscan' (401 without); without that key there is no Tronscan row (labels come from P358). Key-terms: keys from a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (key_plans) before corporate use.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P207 cond 4-5). Research C0497 (verified_needs_key: 401 openresty HTML without TRON-PRO-API-KEY, 2026-11-25). Called only when the 'tronscan' key is configured (no Tronscan row otherwise); success fixtures are captured with the team key (backlog p1-G09-1).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G09-1 (P207 tron_explorer). Key-terms: runs under the corporate profile once key_plans.tronscan is 'business'.
